from pathlib import Path
import yaml,json
p=Path('.github/workflows/benchmark-smoke.yml');x=yaml.safe_load(p.read_text())
s=x['jobs']['z3-smoke']['steps']
paths=s[-1]['with']['path'].splitlines()
assert len(paths)==5
producers='\n'.join(str(v.get('run',''))for v in s[:-1])
assert all(path.rstrip('/')in producers for path in paths)
assert s[-1]['uses']=='actions/upload-artifact@v4'
print(json.dumps(dict(yaml_parses=True,selected_outputs=paths,producers_present=True)))
